name: Enemy_Create
notes: Actor type 0x30 constructor (task fn on the spawn frame): kind/variant/behaviour from params bytes 0..2, Enemy_InitHp, Anim_InitEnemy, callbacks +0x12EC/+0x12F0, Enemy_SetupKind, counters 0x009C7006/0x009C904A ++, fn = Enemy_Update. Capture-checked

name: Enemy_SetupKind
notes: Record flags 2/4/8 -> obj+0x38; switch on kind (+0x1F4): 2/3 gas flags, 9/0x12 fade-in, 0xC, 0xE; kind 0x12 spawns a kind-9 child task

name: Enemy_UpdateKind9
notes: Task fn used instead of Enemy_Update for kind 9 (child of kind 0x12)

name: Enemy_Update
notes: Per-frame: hit-track flags, Enemy_ProcessHits, behaviour 0x00592AE8[+0x1310], pos += vel, Enemy_AnimateSkeleton, target/view/hit-sphere registration, water hook, motion sounds

name: Enemy_DrawNode
notes: Per-node draw callback (anim+0x1158): head look for slot 2, special animated/attached models by id, else Enemy_DrawNodeModel(node model id)

name: Enemy_HeadLook
notes: Turns +0x1320/+0x1324 towards the camera by <= 0xC0 per frame within +-0x4000 of the body yaw, applies rotY/rotX. Capture: +0xC0 per frame

name: Enemy_ProcessHits
notes: If 0x34 & 8: Enemy_CollectShots, per player hit effects; kill -> 0x136C |= 0x80000000, voice, behaviour 9 (scripted/variant 5,6) or 6; else Enemy_HitReaction

name: Enemy_CollectShots
notes: Shot_PlayerOrder, then per shooting player: 0x009A2D88[p] = obj+0x190+p, Enemy_ApplyShot unless 0x34 & 0x100, clears hit bits

name: Shot_PlayerOrder
notes: 0x009C8908[2] = shooting players from 0x009C7000 (0 P1, 1 P2, 2 both: 1 rand picks the order)

name: Enemy_ApplyShot
notes: Damage = 0x004C8350[kind][stage+slot*6] + rank mod, hit type from 0x004C7160 (wound/sever/plain/deflect), node stage/flags, kill flag 0x4000000, scores. Ported (EnemyApplyShot), 7/7 capture events

name: Enemy_RankDamageMod
notes: (signed char)0x004D0D84[kind][slot*16 + rank 0x009C8E96]; 0 if no table; kind 0x17 maps slots > 15 to 0

name: Enemy_SubtractHp
notes: obj+0x11C -= damage unless 0x34 & 0x1000

name: Enemy_SetNodeWound
signature: void __cdecl (NodeState* n, int model, int slot)
notes: Unless 0x34 & 0x200: node model = model, wound data via Enemy_LookupWound, lost-part bit 0x004C4D18[slot] in +0x1318

name: Enemy_LookupWound
signature: int __cdecl (NodeState* n, int model, int kind)
notes: Searches the wound table 0x004D032C[kind] (20-byte entries) for the model; copies 4 values into the node record +0x78..+0x84

name: Skel_FindNodeBySlot
notes: Depth-first search of the current actor's skeleton for a node with the slot

name: Enemy_SeverSubtree
notes: Calls Enemy_SeverNode on the children of the slot's node

name: Enemy_SeverNode
notes: Sets the lost-part bit, clears the node model and +0x78, recurses into children

name: Game_GetRank
notes: Returns (short)0x009C8E96 (dynamic difficulty rank 0..15)

name: Enemy_InitHp
notes: hp = max hp = clamp(+0x11E + 0x005776B0[difficulty 0x009C8E94 (2 in game mode 5)], 1, 300). Ported

name: Enemy_PlayVoice
notes: 0 hurt (rand%5, ret 0x0040A737), 1 body death (rand%5, 0x0040A778), 2 head death (rand&1, 0x0040A7B9), 3 attack (rand&1), 4 fixed

name: Enemy_HitEffects
notes: Blood/effect at the hit node's world point by hit type, knock-back push task 0x00407310 (0.75/0.5/1.0), variant re-evaluation 0x00454270

name: Enemy_UpdateVariantAfterHit
notes: Re-derives variant +0x130C from node models for kinds 1/2/0xE/0x13/0x14 (e.g. lost weapon); variant 5 when both lost-part bits 0x004C4D1D/0x004C4D20 are set

name: Enemy_HitReaction
notes: Non-lethal hit: +0x1319 = hit side (slot 1/2), kind 10 special grab-release, else Enemy_PlayHitMotion

name: Enemy_PlayHitMotion
notes: Hit-reaction motion from 0x00592FC8[kind][variant][0x004C84A8[slot]]: upper-body track (0x00411B70) or full body; sets 0x34 |= 0x40000000

name: Enemy_UpdateHitFlags
notes: Clears hit-reaction flags 0x136C & 0x3000 when the reaction motions are done; then 0x34 &= ~0x40000000

name: Enemy_UpdateUpperBody
notes: Re-triggers the upper-body hit motion (0x00592CBC[kind][variant]+0x10+side*4) while 0x136C & 0x300

name: Enemy_AnimateSkeleton
notes: Enemy_EvalSkeleton(obj+0x194, obj+0x40, obj+0x20C), then anim counters +0x194/+0x198 += 1 unless 0x34 & 0x4000 (capture: 376/376 ticks)

name: Enemy_PostRootCallback
notes: anim+0x115C callback after root motion: push by other objects, wall collision 0x00405B10/0x004057F0, Enemy_SnapToFloor unless dying, collision sphere

name: Enemy_SnapToFloor
notes: y = floor height at y+6 unless 0x136C & 0x4000000 and more than 10 above -> behaviour 11 (fall)

name: Enemy_BehDie
notes: Behaviour 6: Enemy_StartDeathMotion, Enemy_OnDeath, at motion end Enemy_EnterCorpse (or behaviour 0xC if 0x34 & 0x1000000)

name: Enemy_CorpseTwitch
notes: For death motions 0x3D9..0x3E0/0x3F7/0x3F8/0x404/0x41A/0x1DF: 1 rand, anim counter = hold table[(r%17)>>4] (0x0059301C..). Ported, 238/238 capture frames

name: Enemy_BehCorpse
notes: Behaviour 7: 120 frames, y -= 0.04, Enemy_CorpseTwitch, then Actor_Destroy. Capture-checked

name: Enemy_BehCorpseB
notes: Behaviour 8: corpse variant for kinds 3 / 0x12

name: Enemy_BehDeathFall
notes: Behaviour 9: death motion, knock-back jump to a rand-offset view-space point (2 rands), gravity -0.0368, bounces x-0.25 while |vy| > 0.15, then Enemy_EnterCorpse. Capture-checked

name: Enemy_Despawn
notes: Behaviour 10: release target, live/attacker counts -1, free 0x009A5EC0 slot, Actor_Destroy

name: Enemy_BehIdle
notes: Behaviour 1: random idle motion (rand start tick), decides walk (2), 5 or 0x21

name: Enemy_BehApproach
notes: Behaviour 2: walk towards the camera; in range -> Enemy_PickTarget -> attack (3 / 0x34)

name: Enemy_BehAttack
notes: Behaviour 3: attack entry 0x00592F18[kind][variant] (rand), Enemy_FaceTarget, at the hit tick 0x00456490 damages the player

name: Enemy_PickTarget
notes: Chooses the player to attack (+0x121), rand in the 2-player branches; marks 0x009A2BA0[p]; off-screen -> 0x136C |= 0x20000. Capture: 2/2 picks

name: Enemy_FaceTarget
notes: rot.y (+0x68) = yaw from Cam_DirToAngles(pos - point); point = camera pos + RotY(cam yaw)*((1-2p)*-1.2, 0, -1.5) (+0x13E4)

name: Enemy_StartDeathMotion
notes: Death motion by variant/flags (kinds 15..17 scripted: 0x3DB), Anim_BlendTo(..., 5). Capture: motion 987 + 6 blend frames

name: Enemy_DecLiveCount
notes: Once (obj+0x38 bit 2): 0x009C904A -= 1 (event op 0x44 waits on it). Capture: at the kill frame

name: Enemy_DecAttackerCount
notes: Once (obj+0x38 bit 4): 0x009C7006 -= 1

name: Enemy_OnDeath
notes: Enemy_ReleaseTarget; unless counted-out (0x38 & 1): 0x34 |= 0x10000, free 0x009A5EC0 slot, Enemy_DecLiveCount

name: Enemy_EnterCorpse
notes: 0x34 |= 0xC000 (hold), Enemy_DecAttackerCount, anim counter -1, behaviour 7 (8 for kinds 3/0x12)

name: Enemy_HookWater
notes: Hook 0x00592BC0[0], every frame: in water stages (0x009CAC40 5/0x37) splash once when below the water level

name: Enemy_HookLandingDust
notes: Hook [2]: effect 0x46 (water: 0x61) at the floor, once (0x136C |= 0x10000). Capture: set on the first bounce

name: Enemy_HookSpawnSplash
notes: Hook [3]: variant 6 only: splash effects 0x61/0x62

name: Enemy_BehLunge
notes: Behaviour 23: params {kind/variant/beh, trigger id, motion, attack tick}; play motion, on trigger pick+face target, at the tick Player_TakeHit, at the end effect 0x62 + Enemy_Despawn. Capture: states 0-2

name: Enemy_MotionSounds
notes: Sound cues at fixed ticks of motions 0xB

name: Enemy_JumpSetup
signature: void __cdecl (float x0, float y0, float z0, float x1, float y1, float z1)
notes: +0x13C0/+0x13CC, counter 0, duration = max(minT, ftol(xzdist / (30/minT))), minT 15 (10). Ported, capture-checked

name: Enemy_JumpSetupFixed
signature: void __cdecl (float x0, float y0, float z0, float x1, float y1, float z1, int duration)
notes: Same with an explicit duration

name: Enemy_JumpStep
notes: While counter < T: vel = linear x/z, vy = n*-0.027222 + (T*T*0.027222 + 2dy)/(2T); returns 1. Ported, 30/30 frames exact

name: Actor_StopMotion
notes: Zeroes velocity +0x4C..0x54 and acceleration +0x58..0x60 of the current actor

name: Actor_Destroy
notes: 0x34 = (0x34 & ~1) | 0x80018000, 0x00405220, frees the actor slot 0x009C88C0[+0x3C], Task_Kill

name: Actor_RegisterSlot
notes: First free entry of 0x009C88C0[14] -> +0x3C, obj+0x38 |= 0x40

name: Actor_RegisterTarget
notes: If alive and not killed: appends (ftol depth, obj) to 0x005A4D58[14] (count 0x005A4D50); likely target list for the demo player

name: Actor_UpdateViewPos
notes: +0x70 = view-space of +0x100 (matrix 0x009A6000 + cam*0x1A4), hit-sphere registration 0x00405160, +0x104 += yOffset, depth list 0x00408EC0

name: Actor_RegisterHitSphere
notes: Appends obj with its collision sphere (+0x12C) to 0x0059D8E8 (count 0x005A4C80) when in front of the camera

name: Coll_FloorHeight
signature: float __cdecl (float x, float y, float z)
notes: Ray down from y (minus 0x004C49C4) via 0x004053B0: hit -> 0x009CAC58, else 0x009C8E58

name: Actor_IsOnScreen
notes: Projects +0x70 with 0x009A2D70; 1 if inside the screen bounds

name: Player_CanBeTargeted
notes: 0x009C6F08 == 2 and (game mode 5 or player state 0x009A5C62[p] == 5)

name: Player_TakeHit
signature: void __cdecl (int player, int flag, short kind)
notes: Unless invulnerable or game mode 5: life 0x009A5C66[p] -1, score -100, rank -2, invulnerable 0x5A frames

name: Player_AddScore
notes: 0x009A5C6C[p*0x4C] += points (doubled in mode 1 for flag 2), clamped >= 0

name: Game_UpdateRank
notes: Rank 0x009C8E96: + player-count change*4, +1/+2 every 1800 frames, + pending 0x009A3794, clamped 0..15

name: Evt_WaitEnemies
notes: Opcode 0x44: yields until 0x009C904A <= arg and the camera state 0x007DCCA4/0x009C6F2D/0x007DCCA8 allows

name: Anim_InitEnemy
signature: void __cdecl (Anim* a, float* pos, void* nodeBuffer)
notes: Rename of the old Enemy_Create hypothesis: scale by skeleton type, counters, flags (+0x64 = 3, rot order 5), attachments 0x0052ED08, Enemy_InitPose, callbacks, Actor_RegisterSlot

name: Anim_ApplyRootMotion
notes: If skeleton flag 2: x/z (and y with flag 0x10) delta of the motion root, rotated/scaled by the actor, added to the actor position; calls anim+0x115C; pushes the actor transform (rotation order anim+0x68)

name: Enemy_EvalSkeleton
signature: void __cdecl (Anim* a, float* pos, void* nodeBuffer)
notes: push, Enemy_DrawSkeleton, pop, 0x0040A590

name: Anim_SetMotion
notes: Track 0 motion = id, counters/tick/frame/blend reset

name: Anim_BlendTo
signature: void __cdecl (Anim* a, int motion, int tick, char n)
notes: Track 0 blends to motion at tick over n+1 frames (flag 1), tick held, then counter = tick+1. Capture: n=5 -> 6 frames

name: Anim_StartBlend
signature: void __cdecl (Anim* a, int node, int motion, int track)
notes: Loads the from/to node angle sets for a blend (Anim_LoadPose 0x00411C20)

name: Anim_TrackTick0
notes: tick = counter % (len+1), frame = tick/2, odd ticks interpolate (flag 0x20); blend countdown; +0x5D/+0x5E end flags. Ported, 376/376

name: Anim_TrackTick1
notes: Same for the upper-body track 1 (+0x04/+0x0C/+0x1C/+0x24), loops +0x33 times, then switches the track off

name: Anim_BlendTrack1
signature: void __cdecl (Anim* a, int node, int motion, int tick, char n)
notes: Upper-body track blend (flags 9)

name: Anim_BlendTrack1Loop
signature: void __cdecl (Anim* a, int node, int motion, int tick, char n, char loops)
notes: Upper-body track blend with loop count

name: Anim_LoadPose
signature: void __cdecl (int which, int motion, int frame, int track)
notes: which 0: current root, 1/2: blend from/to, 0xC: copy current; per node via 0x00411EC0 and Enemy_LoadNodeAngles

name: Anim_ResetNodes
notes: Resets the per-node track selectors of the (sub)skeleton
